description: This file contains static functions and definitions related to generating XML test summaries, including functions for opening, writing, and closing XML tags, as well as initializing and shutting down the summary process. It manages report data structures and outputs test results in a structured format.

methods.name: clar_summary_close_tag
methods.description: Closes an XML tag with proper indentation.

methods.name: clar_summary_testsuites
methods.description: Starts the XML document with a <testsuites> tag.

methods.name: clar_summary_testsuite
methods.description: Creates a <testsuite> XML element with metadata.

methods.name: clar_summary_testcase
methods.description: Creates a <testcase> XML element with test details.

methods.name: clar_summary_failure
methods.description: Creates a <failure> XML element with error info.

methods.name: clar_summary_skipped
methods.description: Marks a test as skipped in XML.

methods.name: clar_summary_init
methods.description: Initializes a summary object and opens the output file.

methods.name: clar_summary_shutdown
methods.description: Finalizes the report, writes remaining tags, and frees resources.
